definitions.explanation: describes refined, elegant beauty, often used for people or relationships

examples.japanese: {麗|うるわ}しい⟦{友情|ゆうじょう}→友情：03648_yuujou⟧。
{麗|うるわ}しい⟦{姿|すがた}→姿：03363_sugata⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{見|み}とれた。
examples.english: I was captivated by her beautiful figure.

examples.japanese: ⟦{春|はる}→春：00627_haru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{麗|うるわ}しい⟦{陽気|ようき}→陽気：03657_youki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{包|つつ}まれた→包む：01226_tsutsumu⟧⟦{一日|いちにち}→一日：00942_ichinichi⟧だった。
examples.english: It was a day wrapped in the lovely spring weather.

notes:
USAGE:
- {麗|うるわ}しい⟦{友情|ゆうじょう}→友情：03648_yuujou⟧ (beautiful friendship)
- {麗|うるわ}しい⟦{姿|すがた}→姿：03363_sugata⟧ (lovely figure)
- {麗|うるわ}しい⟦{関係|かんけい}→関係：01298_kankei⟧ (beautiful relationship)
A literary, elevated word for beauty. Implies refined elegance and grace rather than mere physical attractiveness. Often used in formal or poetic contexts.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{美|うつく}しい→美しい：01121_utsukushii⟧ - general beauty (more common)
- {麗|うるわ}しい - refined, graceful beauty (more literary)
- {綺麗|きれい} - pretty, clean (casual)

FORMS:
- Adverb: {麗|うるわ}しく
